## Relation interface

A relation as `g.relation()` returns it, typed by its ends, its id and its link attributes:  paths are built from it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Relation<F extends string, T extends string, Id extends string, L extends Attrs> extends RelationDef 
```
**Extends:** [RelationDef](./hopgraph.relationdef.md)
